definitions.explanation: The color of gold; a bright yellow metallic color associated with gold.

examples.japanese: {夕日|ゆうひ}で{空|そら}が{金色|きんいろ}に{染|そ}まった。
examples.english: The sky was dyed golden by the setting sun.

examples.japanese: {金色|きんいろ}の{髪|かみ}をした{外国人|がいこくじん}がいた。
examples.english: There was a foreigner with golden hair.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{銀杏|いちょう}が{金色|きんいろ}に{色|いろ}づく。
examples.english: In autumn, ginkgo trees turn golden.

notes:
READING NOTES:
- {金色|きんいろ} is the standard reading
- {金色|こんじき} is a more literary/poetic reading

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {金色|きんいろ}の + noun (golden ~)
- {金色|きんいろ}に{輝|かがや}く (to shine golden)
- {金色|きんいろ}に{染|そ}まる (to be dyed golden)

RELATED COLORS:
- {銀色|ぎんいろ} (silver color)
- {黄金色|こがねいろ} (golden color, more literary)
